column1: # Cache hints of operands A and B as the engine gets them. The tensor data mover loads the operands
# of the TDMInst bit mask a solution name spells (`_TDMI<n>_`; bit 0 A, bit 1 B), and a loaded
# operand has cache hint 0; any other operand has TensileLite's: 4 for TemporalHint 1 or 3 when the
# kernel has temporal hints, else its NonTemporal field. tests/test_dat.py reads these cases with
# lib/dat.py, and TensileLite's PredictionLibrary_test.cpp with TilewrightRanker::makeConfig.
# name has_temporal_hint temporal_hint_a temporal_hint_b non_temporal_a non_temporal_b tdm_inst cache_hint_a cache_hint_b
